style: Use case: product-mockup. Create one standalone 1536x1024 landscape workflow illustration for an OpnForm integration page. Match supplied STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: white/light neutral canvas, near-black geometric sans text, saturated blue #2563EB, restrained pale-blue dot grid, fine borders, subtle rounded cards and soft shadows, flat purposeful product illustration. Generous margins. Short legible English text. No large page headline, navigation, browser/device bezel, traffic-light controls, watermark, purple gradient, 3D objects, fake business metrics or testimonial. Illustrative UI, never pretend this is an exact application screenshot. Distinct integration subject:

images.prompt: An OpnForm contact response card, with Name, Email and Message fields, connected by a blue dotted arrow to an email inbox card titled New form submission. Show two small recipient chips Sales and Support. Short illustrative message only.

An OpnForm demo request card with Name, Company, Interest fields, connected by a blue dotted arrow to a Slack-style channel panel titled #sales showing a New demo request notification and a View submission action. Small Slack mark, no invented exact setup screen.

An OpnForm community application card with Username, Interests fields, connected by a blue dotted arrow to a Discord-style channel panel titled #applications with a New community application notification. Small Discord mark.

An OpnForm response card connected by a blue dotted arrow marked POST to a clean API endpoint card labeled Webhook, displaying a tiny JSON snippet with name and email keys and a small 200 OK badge. Use placeholder data.

A clean left-to-right workflow: OpnForm New submission trigger card, an orange-accented Zapier action card, then a CRM contact card and a team notification card. Short labels New submission, Create contact, Notify team. Blue connective dotted arrows.

An OpnForm event registration card with Name, Email, Session fields connected by a blue dotted arrow to a Google Sheets-style spreadsheet with columns Name, Email, Session and one pale-blue highlighted new row. Small green Sheets mark.

An OpnForm service request card with Name, Request fields connected by a blue dotted arrow to a flat Telegram chat panel titled Form alerts with a New service request message and View submission action. No phone bezel. Small Telegram mark.

An OpnForm Workshop registration form card with Name, Email fields and a payment line Workshop fee $25 connected to a simplified Stripe secure payment card with card details placeholders and a Pay $25 button. Small Stripe wordmark. Illustrative fixed one-time payment.

An OpnForm New submission trigger node feeding an n8n workflow with three spaced nodes labeled Validate data, Internal API, Notify team. Use tidy blue connectors and restrained coral n8n accent. A small JSON data card beneath one node.

An OpnForm Volunteer signup form card feeding an Activepieces flow with clear stacked cards labeled New submission, Add to roster, Send welcome message. Blue connectors, restrained amber accent, generous whitespace.

An OpnForm Request form card feeding a Make workflow visual with a central router splitting to two paths labeled Sales request and Support request, ending in CRM and Help desk cards. Restrained violet Make accent, blue connective lines.

An OpnForm Event signup card feeding a Pabbly Connect workflow with clean cards New submission, Add attendee, Send confirmation. Spreadsheet-like attendee card at the right. Restrained green accent and blue connectors.

An OpnForm Inquiry form card feeding an Albato automation panel with cards New submission, Map fields, Create CRM lead. Show short mapping rows Email → Email, Company → Company. Restrained coral accent, blue connectors.
